title: Shravana Banthu
desc: Kailash and Urvashi's relationship remains unfulfilled due to a tragedy in their past lives. Years later, Kailash's friend Vishwas tries to reunite the lovers in their present births.

title: Sneha
desc: Murali saves Lakshmi from an abusive marriage and shelters her at his house. However, all hell breaks loose when Murali's girlfriend finds out about their living situation.

title: Grama Devathe
desc: Angala Parameswari, an avatar of Goddess Parvati, wants to protect the people of Earth. Kaveri, her ardent follower, seeks her help when her life is in danger.

title: Clap
desc: An ambitious athlete gets his dreams shattered following a devastating injury. Later, he coaches a young talent and fights against corrupt officials.

title: Ugramm
desc: Agastya, an automobile mechanic with a dangerous past, takes it upon himself to protect Nithya, a kidnapped girl, from the vengeful son of a ruthless gangster.
